title: COOKIE DOUGH BLENDED OATS
description:
COOKIE DOUGH BLENDED OATS… for weight loss?! YES please 👇🔥

These sweet, creamy blended oats are packed with hidden chickpeas + cauliflower — high fibre, low calorie density, and so satisfying 🙌

I lost 60 lbs eating HUGE portions and sweet treats like this every single day — and you can too 💚

💚 Whole-food & oil-free
💚 High-volume, low-calorie
💚 Breakfast that actually keeps you full

Get all my vegan oil-free eBooks for maximum weight loss — link in my bio ✨

⸻

Ingredients
 • ½ cup chickpeas
 • 1 cup frozen cauliflower
 • ½ cup oats
 • 1 ripe banana
 • 1–2 dates
 • ⅓ cup unsweetened plant milk
 • 1 tsp vanilla
 • Pinch of salt

Optional: melted dark chocolate for that magic shell moment 🍫✨

Blend everything until smooth, pour into a glass (wine glass = fancy ✨), top with melted dark chocolate, chill for 5 mins and enjoy!
